title: Requirements generated and ranked
description: 4 groups created from customer feedback, market studies, sales intelligence, and PM delivery constraints.

requirements.statement: Strengthen the vehicle’s exterior character while retaining a recognizably BMW appearance.
Make body-equipment functions reliable and their operating states immediately understandable.
Make tire status, operating limitations, and required driver actions clear throughout normal use.
Improve the fit, finish, and everyday usability of the front door finisher panel.
Make run-flat tire status and post-puncture driving guidance clear to the driver.
Illuminate the full luggage area without leaving loading zones or corners obscured.
Create a distinctive, coherent front and rear lighting signature that remains recognizably BMW.
Make the luggage area easy to access, load, and use without avoidable obstruction.
Resolve documented exterior-quality concerns while preserving the intended BMW design character.
Make hands-free trunk opening reliable and provide immediate confirmation when the gesture is detected.
Keep frequently used vehicle controls discoverable within one clear interaction path.
Keep Head-Up Display content readable, correctly positioned, and easy to configure.
Make ConnectedDrive and infotainment services reliable, responsive, and easy to navigate.
Provide clear route guidance with responsive destination search and current traffic information.
Make cruise-control activation, target speed, and intervention state unambiguous to the driver.
Keep a compatible phone securely positioned and charging reliably throughout the journey.
Recognize supported gestures consistently and confirm each accepted command immediately.
Reduce Bluetooth pairing and reconnection to a clear, recoverable interaction flow.
Provide a clear, timely rear-camera view with dependable guidance during every reversing maneuver.
Recognize natural driver commands reliably and offer a clear recovery path after misunderstood speech.
Make audio modes and sound settings easy to understand, adjust, and verify.
Maintain a quiet, temperature-stable cabin during everyday and long-distance driving.
Organize the front center console so storage and controls are easy to reach and use.
Limit intrusive road, wind, and drivetrain noise while preserving clear in-cabin audio.
Make seat-belt access, fastening, and status feedback comfortable and immediately clear.
Preserve an open cabin impression while keeping passenger space practical and unobstructed.
Deliver the selected airflow quickly and make blower level and direction easy to verify.
Deliver even seat heating and ventilation with clear, responsive level controls.
Create a coherent premium interior through clear layout, material quality, and visual consistency.
Provide supportive seat comfort and intuitive adjustment throughout long-distance driving.
Provide progressive, predictable braking response across low-speed and normal-road driving.
Apply the correct driver profile reliably and make profile switching immediately visible.
Strengthen occupants’ sense of safety through clear vehicle-state and assistance feedback.
Issue timely lane-departure warnings without nuisance intervention and clearly show when the system is active.
Deliver smooth, well-timed gear changes and clearly communicate the selected drive state.
Make ground clearance behavior consistent and its controls easy to identify during normal use.
Make wifi hotspot behavior consistent and its controls easy to identify during normal use.
Keep route guidance updated with timely traffic, signal, and road-condition information.
Make high-voltage charging power socket behavior consistent and its controls easy to identify during normal use.
Make through-loading facility behavior consistent and its controls easy to identify during normal use.
